settings.source: fixed fixture defaults; only copied synthetic fixtures are searched

semantics.recall: fraction of required evidence units fully covered in the first k returned excerpts, macro-averaged over complete positive searches
semantics.mrr: reciprocal rank of the first returned excerpt fully covering at least one required evidence unit
semantics.negatives: correct only for a fully scanned, complete result with no excerpt; errors and partial scans are ineligible
semantics.limitations: development pilot on small synthetic fixtures, not held-out, not an agent end-to-end or multilingual quality benchmark
semantics.caps: input tokens are conservative local reservations, not a guaranteed billing ceiling
